item.title: SoftBank shares climb 14% despite investment giant posting $7 billion quarterly loss on data-centre costs
item.description: SoftBank shares rose 14% Tuesday before the company reported a $7 billion quarterly net loss, announced after markets closed. The loss reflected costly US data-centre investments, rising financing expenses and volatile portfolio valuations, despite sales growth and an investment gain from ByteDance.

item.description: Balrampur Chini expects its ₹3,080-crore, 80,000-tonne-per-year PLA plant in Uttar Pradesh to begin commercial operations in Q4FY27. The project could add about ₹2,000 crore in annual revenue. September-quarter profit rose 88.9%, and the company declared a ₹4-per-share interim dividend.
